an owner's own save is refused while the kernel holds another edit, instead of today's both-versions write (docs/config-files.md rule 3), until the kernel ConfigPort offers an owner-acknowledged write (Gate's judgeConfigWrite judges the whole patched file, so an owner's plain save over a held edit could otherwise put that edit into effect); a broken file or a hand edit the kernel has not reloaded yet is overwritten with the value in effect (every setting is written from the settings in effect plus the owner's patch), never put into effect, but lost (a file with a top-level key the schema does not know is refused instead; the owner repairs it by hand); refusing a write over a file that moved since the kernel's last reload, so such an edit is held instead, waits on the kernel
